description: This file defines the Document class within the OpenCart framework, which manages HTML document metadata such as title, description, keywords, links, styles, scripts, and meta tags. It provides methods to set and retrieve these properties, indicating it is used for generating or managing the HTML head content of web pages.

classes.name: Document
classes.description: A class that encapsulates HTML document metadata such as title, description, keywords, links, styles, scripts, and meta tags. It provides methods to add and retrieve these elements, facilitating dynamic HTML head content generation.

methods.name: addLink
methods.description: Adds a link tag with href and rel attributes to the document.

methods.name: addStyle
methods.description: Adds a stylesheet link to the document with optional media attribute.

methods.name: addScript
methods.description: Adds a script tag with href to the document.

methods.name: addMeta
methods.description: Adds a meta tag with specified attributes (e.g., name, property, content, media).
